title: Introducing Smart Triage
summary: The August 2026 Smart Triage pilot introduces practice-configured routing and appointment booking to help patients reach the right care.
body_markdown:
Smart Triage lets practices configure automations for incoming patient requests. We introduced it in August 2026 as an early-access feature, with a pilot ahead of general release.


## Routing and booking


In the product walkthrough, Clinical Product Lead Dr Souradip shows how requests that meet a practice’s criteria can be routed automatically. Examples include directing eligible Pharmacy First requests to a chosen pharmacy and booking patients into predefined appointment slots.


The practice configures the criteria and destinations. Every case remains logged so a GP can review it when needed.


[Watch Dr Souradip’s walkthrough](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7497594078184857600/)


## A conversation with Alan Hall


To play this YouTube video here, allow marketing cookies.


[Watch on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=utqIedoRkbo)


Anima’s Head of GTM, Alan Hall, discusses the work behind Smart Triage and the aim of reducing time spent manually processing routine requests while retaining oversight.


## One platform, shaped by practice feedback


In follow-up interviews, Alan explains why Anima brings triage, documents and referrals into one platform. The team also discusses how practice feedback shapes new features, including Smart Triage.


[Ask about Smart Triage and pilot availability](https://www.animahealth.com/contact/sales)
